prior_findings.title: Moved-head retry is skipped when an earlier disposition/run refusal masks the selection replacement
prior_findings.assessment: Column-select current_head removes identity-map reuse, and StaleHeadError caused by a simple same-disposition replacement correctly requests a fresh transaction, bounded to three attempts. The deterministic PG test has the right shape for that case: it pauses after the unlocked head read, replaces the title selection under the existing run/disposition, then expects version 2. However, head movement is checked only in the StaleHeadError handler. Other currentness refusals return the original selection/version without checking whether it still fills the slot.
prior_findings.scenario: Reader captures S1/version1 bound to disposition D1, then pauses before _require_current locks the heads. Another session issues D2 (for example a renewed ACCEPT disposition), creates a preview bound to D2, and selects S2/version2 into the same slot. On resume, _require_current sees D2 != S1.preview.disposition_id and raises DispositionStaleError at line 1013 before it reaches the packaging-head check at line 1014. _project_slot catches that at 872 and returns S1/version1/exportable=false at 888, potentially alongside READY/D2 from its later readiness read. The UI labels S1 Current selection and withholds a valid S2 export until another refresh. A run/profile replacement can similarly mask the moved selection. This is a current-state projection defect; it does not grant stale export/download authority.
prior_findings.verification: A fresh controlled Python branch probe executed the actual _project_slot code object in an isolated globals namespace with minimal repository stand-ins and a real PackageSelection fixture. The simulated currentness refusal moved the head to S2 and raised DispositionStaleError. The result retained S1/exportable=false and performed only one current_head read, proving that branch never rechecks/retries. This is not a real database interleaving. The authorized PG interleaving test could not execute because socket creation is denied.
prior_findings.fix: Check the slot head after every caught currentness refusal, and retry the complete projection in a new transaction whenever selection/version changed, not only after StaleHeadError. Preserve the existing global lock order. Add a deterministic PG test that advances disposition and selects a package bound to that disposition while the first head read is paused; expect S2/version2 with its own readiness/history. A compatible retry for early profile/run refusals should receive equivalent coverage.
